standard.summary: SageAttn 漂移检测超阈值后的处置：warn 只记日志继续用 SageAttn；fallback_sdpa 自动把 attention 后端切回 SDPA。
standard.effect: warn（默认）保留速度、把风险交给人看日志；fallback_sdpa 牺牲 SageAttn 的加速换取数值安全，切换后本次训练不再切回。
standard.whenToUse: 无人值守的长训任务建议 fallback_sdpa，漂移时自动降级保平安；有人盯日志的短实验用 warn 即可。
standard.avoidWhen: sageattn_drift_check_interval=0（检测关闭）时本项不参与；对速度极端敏感且已确认模型与 SageAttn 兼容时无需 fallback。

standard_en.summary: What happens once SageAttn's drift detection exceeds the threshold: warn only logs it and carries on using SageAttn; fallback_sdpa switches the attention backend back to SDPA automatically.
standard_en.effect: warn (the default) keeps the speed and leaves the risk to whoever reads the log; fallback_sdpa gives up SageAttn's acceleration for numerical safety, and once switched this run does not switch back.
standard_en.whenToUse: fallback_sdpa is advisable for a long unattended run, downgrading automatically on drift to stay safe; warn is fine for a short experiment with someone watching the log.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It plays no part when sageattn_drift_check_interval=0 (detection off); no fallback is needed when you care about speed above all and have confirmed the model works with SageAttn.

advanced.principle: 量化漂移通常随训练分布变化渐进出现，一次超阈值往往预示后续持续劣化；自动回退把「发现问题→人工干预」的延迟压缩为零，代价是从此失去量化加速。
advanced.intervention: training_loop_init_core.py 把 fallback 策略传入 AttentionDriftMonitor；监视器在对比误差超 sageattn_drift_threshold 时执行对应动作。
advanced.expectedImpact: fallback_sdpa 触发后吞吐回落到 SDPA 水平，训练数值恢复全精度 attention 语义。
advanced.tradeoffs: warn 模式下漂移持续存在可能积累训练偏差；fallback 模式误报（阈值过严）会白白丢掉加速。

advanced_en.principle: Quantization drift usually appears gradually as the training distribution shifts, and one over-threshold event often predicts continued degradation; automatic fallback compresses the "notice problem → manual intervention" delay to zero, at the cost of losing the quantization speedup from then on.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop_init_core.py passes the fallback strategy into AttentionDriftMonitor; the monitor executes the corresponding action when the comparison error exceeds sageattn_drift_threshold.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: After fallback_sdpa triggers, throughput falls back to SDPA levels and training numerics recover full-precision attention semantics.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: In warn mode, persistent drift can accumulate training bias; in fallback mode, false positives (threshold too strict) throw away the speedup for nothing.
